text: {"lessons":["Selling below cost can be sensible when the outlook or risk changes; judge a position by its future prospects, not by whether a loss is realized.","Repeatedly trimming C and D as prices fell did not prevent further declines; use a clear, consistent plan for reassessing a weakening trend rather than reacting trade by trade.","The account’s modest overall gain came amid sharp swings, so preserve cash, diversify exposure, and avoid assuming that frequent trades will outperform the market."]}
